gaps.term: compact (unit ball is compact; supremum is attained)
gaps.quote: In finite dimensions the unit ball is compact, so the supremum is attained and is a maximum.
gaps.note: Compact sets are not in the reader's profile and the page neither explains nor links the term. The claim that the supremum is attained, and so is a maximum, rests on compactness and cannot be checked from what the page gives.

gaps.term: norm on the intermediate space in the composite bound
gaps.note: The first inequality applies the bound for Phi to the vector Psi(xi), so it needs the norm used on Psi's output to be the norm Phi's definition uses on its domain. The page only says each space has a chosen norm, so the reader cannot check that the same norm is meant on the intermediate space.
